t2i_prompt: Flat UI mockup, no device frame, of a <CONTENT> section on a portrait off-white paper drawing sheet with a thin border and a small title block with sheet number in the bottom-right corner. A two-line sentence-case light sans headline with generous margin. Below, stacked numbered row boxes in deep navy hairlines, each with a mono numeral in a narrow cell and a one-line statement. One row is open: a steel-blue filled bar with white text, then a two-column panel with a sand-beige header strip and a small fine-line pipe-fitting detail drawing with dimension lines. Square corners, no shadows, calm spacing.
signature_idea: Failure modes listed as numbered sheet rows that unfold into cause versus design control, with a detail drawing as proof.
strengths: honest framing (where things fail) builds credibility with validation leads
very readable rows with numbers and units in the statement
one open row at a time keeps it calm
headline weight is close to Geist light
weaknesses: red status dot and beige strip introduce colours outside the palette
steel-blue filled bar is a heavy use of the single accent
expanded body text is placeholder gibberish
brand_fit_why: Limestone sheet, navy lines, steel-blue accent, square corners and calm space fit; the red dot and beige strip stray outside the one-accent palette.
